english.title: Holder of a trade licence use more than permitted vehicles
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of

(A)_[a trade licence,]_
(B)_[trade licences,]_

used at any one time on a public road a greater number of vehicles (for which vehicle licences were not for the time being in force) than you were authorised to use by virtue of the trade

(C)_[licence]_
(D)_[licences]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34(1)(a) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

other.penalty:
An excise penalty being the greater of either:

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.
or
Five times the amount of duty chargeable in respect of the vehicle concerned.

Fixed Penalty Ticket: Fifty pounds fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
36 months
